title: Compensation
description: Represents compensation data for a worker in Workday, including salary plans, allowance plans, bonus plans, and total compensation details.

id.description: The Workday ID of the compensation record.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the compensation record.

worker.description: The worker this compensation belongs to.

effectiveDate.description: The effective date of the compensation.

compensationPlans.description: The compensation plans assigned to the worker.

totalBasePayAmount.description: The total base pay amount across all salary plans.

totalBasePayAnnualizedAmount.description: The annualized total base pay amount.

frequency.description: The pay frequency (e.g., Annual, Monthly, Bi-Weekly, Weekly).

compensationStep.description: The compensation step within the grade.

compaRatio.description: The compa-ratio (current pay relative to midpoint of compensation range).

rangePosition.description: The range position (where in the pay range the worker falls).

payRateType.description: The pay rate type (e.g., Salary, Hourly).

href.description: A link to the full compensation resource.

CompensationPlan.description: A specific compensation plan assigned to a worker.

id.description: The Workday ID of the compensation plan assignment.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the plan.

compensationPlanType.description: The type of plan (e.g., Salary, Allowance, Bonus, Commission, Stock).

frequency.description: The pay frequency for this plan.

effectiveDate.description: The effective date of the plan assignment.

ResourceReference.description: A reference to a Workday resource.

id.description: The Workday ID of the referenced resource.

descriptor.description: A display descriptor for the referenced resource.

href.description: A link to the referenced resource.
